short_description: Surf lessons on Waikīkī Beach, directly in front of The Royal Hawaiian hotel
cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior to activity for a refund.
meeting_point: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815
description: Learn to surf with a private one-on-one lesson from a lifeguard certified Waikīkī Beachboy. Perfect for beginners, this 1.25-hour lesson includes 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand followed by in-water surfing time.
what_is_included:
- Surfboard
- Rash guard rental during the lesson
- 15-minute safety briefing and land lesson before heading into the water.
itinerary:
- 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand
- 1 hour of in-water surfing with a private instructor
highlights:
- Private one-on-one surf lesson with a certified instructor
- Perfect for beginners and kids under 12 years of age
- All instructors are lifeguard and CPR certified
- Learn to surf on Waikīkī Beach, the birthplace of surfing
check_in_details: Check in at least 10-15 minutes before your lesson at the service counter.
special_requirements:
- Participants must be able to swim and be comfortable being submerged under the water.
- Children under 12 years of age are required to take a private one-on-one lesson.
restrictions: - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries may not participate in a surf lesson.
extras:
- Photos and video available for purchase
- All instructors are CPR and lifeguard certified.
faqs:
- **Do I need prior surfing experience?**
No, our Waikīkī Beach surf lessons are perfect for beginners. We can tailor your lesson to meet your surf level.
- **Are children allowed to participate?**
Yes. Children under the age of 12 must take a One-on-one Individual lesson for safety reasons..
- **We have more than one child under 12 and wish to book them all at the same time slot.  I have booked them on different times. Can you modify for us?**
If you have already made your bookings, please email us with all the booking numbers to info@waikikibeachservices.com.  We will be happy to check the availability of our surf instructors and modify if we could.
-  **We have more than one child under 12 and wish to book them all at the same time slot, but we do not see availability online. Can you help?**
Please email us at info@waikikibeachservices.com with 1) The number of children and their ages 2) Preferred date and time of your lesson (choose three) 3) Your full contact information (email address & cell phone number). Once we have received your message, we will contact you within one business day. 
- **Can our family take surf lessons together if we have two children under 12?**
Yes, but you will need to make separate reservations. Each child age under 12 years of age must book a One-on-one Individual Surf Lesson with their own instructor. Adults and guests ages 12 and older may book an appropriate group lesson.
